title: Input: Keyboard handler (key codes, modifiers, shortcuts)
acceptance_criteria: Key down/up events captured with key code (scancode or keycode)
Modifier keys tracked (Ctrl, Shift, Alt) as bitmask
Key repeat events handled (held key generates repeated events)
Shortcut detection: Ctrl+C, Ctrl+V, Ctrl+L, Escape, Enter, Backspace
Arrow key events (Up, Down, Left, Right) for list navigation
Text input events captured for search/filter functionality
Events forwarded to Nuklear input system
Unit test verifies modifier + key combination detection
